title: Select post-agency concept-root follow-up boundary
summary: Use validated agency pilot and deferred-trigger guardrail evidence to choose the next file-structure follow-up before any source movement.

goal.outcome: Post-agency file-structure work has an approved next boundary or renewed deferral before additional source movement happens.
acceptance: Review agency pilot closure evidence, compatibility shims, file-structure audit output, TASK-018 guardrail behavior, and deferred concept roots.
Decide whether the next step is agency shim cleanup, a second concept-root migration boundary, or renewed deferral with owner/trigger/rationale.
If source work is needed, produce executable follow-up task(s) with acceptance, non-goals, verification, and compatibility constraints; do not perform source movement in this task.
Update file-structure KB/diagram only when the accepted boundary changes canonical structure intent.
Planning validation must fail/block if any approved boundary decision is left only as an open question.
non_goals: Do not move non-agency concept roots in this task.
Do not remove agency shims in this task unless a separate implementation task is created and validated later.
Do not change public commands, package entrypoints, adapter schemas, or product behavior.

delta.desired: Maintainers choose or explicitly defer the next concept-root migration boundary with durable roadmap/build evidence.
delta.current: Agency pilot and TASK-018 trigger guardrail are validated; deferred-root trigger is satisfied; no next boundary has been selected.
delta.closure: A decision_build/planning_build maps the post-agency follow-up to executable tasks or renewed deferral.
